notes: This contract records provider- and FOM-independent API checks for the official IEEE 1516.1 enumeration families in C++ and Java. The C++ check verifies distinct values for imported enumerators; the Java check verifies the exact standard enumerator names and set for each corresponding enum. These are API contract checks only and do not claim provider behavior or cross-RTI interoperability.
